observed_current_public_state: Current English Title VI/home content identifies the contact generically as EEO Manager / Equal Employment Opportunity rather than naming the historical role-holder.
Current indexed German and French language versions still name Sheila Stallsworth as EEO manager.
English Title VI/home content still displays rtec@kih.net as the public contact email.
The signed 2026-08-26 EEO policy in the internal canonical library establishes a later current EEO role assignment than the translated website pages.
interpretation: The multilingual public surface appears to contain role-holder/version drift.
The presence of rtec@kih.net is not by itself classified as wrong because it may intentionally remain a public/general mailbox.
Translated pages should not be allowed to preserve obsolete named staff after the English/current canonical policy changes.
Public website content should be versioned and validated against canonical policy/role records rather than edited independently by locale.
risks: Public complaints or civil-rights inquiries may be routed using stale named-role information.
Different languages may give materially different contact instructions.
Agents scraping the public site could reintroduce superseded people into current organizational profiles.
remediation_candidates: Audit all ridertec.org language/localized variants for named HR/EEO contacts and contact channels.
Replace person names with role-based contact labels where appropriate, or drive all locales from one canonical source.
Validate whether rtec@kih.net remains the intended public civil-rights/Title VI mailbox; if yes, document ownership/forwarding and keep it role-managed.
Add website-currentness checks to the HR/document publishing workflow and Agent OS.
source_priority_rule: Signed current internal policy and effective-dated role records outrank stale public translations for internal role determination; public pages remain authoritative evidence of what the public currently sees.
